acceptance: Author-side local ModelSim simulation evidence only. Main acceptance, synthesis, implementation, CDC/RDC, board/system and all29 formal cards are not claimed.
limitations: Author-side local ModelSim simulation only; no main acceptance is claimed.
Actual digital loopback is supplemental and explicitly named; the primary source is independent sample_levels schedules.
Code7 is demonstrated only on a deliberately faulty wrapper copy because the correct composition does not reach it.
Maximum COUNT_W=32 and WITNESS_W=64 coverage is bounded observation, not a claim of full traversal.
The 16-bit period 65535 record is fully observed; 65536 is an overflow observation, not a timing or frequency claim.
Mutant rejection is public-port behavioral evidence, not proof against every possible fault.
No Vivado synthesis or implementation was run because the toolchain is unavailable.

mutants.description: Combinational T guard omits transfer_now, so a pre-existing old matched slot is exported and handshaken on the transfer edge.
T/pending invalidation and rearm are made tag-dependent, so a same-tag reapplication retains and exports an interval that lacks a complete post-boundary cycle.
Raw/expected equality is removed from out_valid, so a mismatching raw slot becomes externally valid and handshakeable.

replacements.old:
assign out_valid = transport_window && c_armed && !raw_fault &&
                       c_out_valid && raw_equal;

mutants.description: Every rearm is suppressed. The correct design never reaches code7; this deliberately faulty copy exposes the defensive code7 path.
